worked.problem: Use the unit circle to find the exact value of sin 30° and identify its quadrant or axis.

Mark the terminal side in quadrant 1.
The reference angle is 30°; use its special-angle ratio.
Apply the sign of sin in quadrant 1: 1/2.
Answer: sin 30° = 1/2. Confirm the sign on the coordinate axes.
